note: Review 3 A12: b_heart (awake), a free recolour of the re-rolled dormant Heart (art/raw/h2/b_heart_dormant.png, h2 frame 0, PixelLab object 59baacf8-c64b-4462-8249-b5f2b175be49). 'node scripts/art/recolor.ts art/edit/h2/edits.json' rebuilds art/edit/h2/b_heart.png. Coordinates are source pixels (100 x 100; art:build trims to the 87 x 88 art at [6, 6] and centres it on the 112 canvas, so sprite = source + 6). Both ops are flood fills inside the #090a14 linework, so they touch the gem and the ring channel and nothing else: the stone, the moss in the inner socket and the outline stay, so it is the same machine.

edits.name: b_heart
edits.note: Awake: the dim navy gem white-hot aqua, and the dark green glass channel round the gear (STYLE: Alien light is #a4dddb in #25562e glass) lit as a ring of aqua light.
